transcript: Speaker A (Narrator): गांव से आई बहू को जिठानी ने सबके सामने बोला, इंग्लिश नहीं आती तो खानदान में कैसे रहेगी? बहू ने इंग्लिश में ऐसा जवाब दिया कि जिठानी के मुंह से एक वर्ड नहीं निकला। [The sister-in-law told the daughter-in-law from the village, 'If you don't know English, how will you live in the family?' The daughter-in-law replied in English in such a way that not a single word came out of the sister-in-law's mouth.] Speaker B (Jethani): सुनो सब, आज शाम को शर्मा जी आ रहे हैं डिनर पे। बहू रानी, प्लीज अंदर रहना, बाहर मत आना। पिछली बार गेस्ट के सामने थैंक यू भी नहीं बोल पाई थी। शर्मा जी एनआरआई हैं, इंग्लिश में बात करेंगे। शर्म आ जाएगी हमें। [Listen everyone, Sharma ji is coming for dinner tonight. Bahu rani, please stay inside, don't come out. Last time you couldn't even say thank you in front of the guests. Sharma ji is an NRI, he will speak in English. We will feel ashamed.] Speaker C (Bahu): भाभी जी, मैं बाहर आऊंगी और मैं बात भी करूंगी। [Bhabhi ji, I will come out and I will also talk.] Speaker B (Jethani): अच्छा? क्या बोलेगी? गुड नाईट बोलेगी डिनर पे? [Oh? What will you say? Will you say good night at dinner?] Speaker C (Bahu): भाभी जी, I understand your concern. But I have been learning English for the past two months. I can hold a basic conversation now. I may not be perfect but I will not embarrass this family. I just need a chance. Speaker B (Jethani): सीख रही है? कहां से? ट्यूशन लगाया क्या गांव वाली इंग्लिश का? [Learning? From where? Did you get tuition for village English?] Speaker C (Bahu): इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप से। रोज 15 मिनट एआई कोच से प्रैक्टिस करती हूं। रात को आप सब सो जाते हैं तब। [From the English Seekho app. I practice with the AI coach for 15 minutes every day. At night when you all go to sleep.] Speaker B (Jethani): ऐप से क्या सीखेगी? [What will you learn from an app?] Speaker A (Narrator): शाम को शर्मा जी आते हैं। [Sharma ji arrives in the evening.] Speaker D (Sharma Ji): Hello, you must be the new member of the family. Speaker C (Bahu): Yes uncle, I am Kavita. I got married three months ago. It is really nice to meet you. How was your flight from London? Speaker D (Sharma Ji): Oh, wonderful. Your English is quite nice, Kavita. Speaker C (Bahu): Thank you, uncle. I am still learning, but I practice every day. Speaker D (Sharma Ji): Your wife is impressive, Rahul. Very well spoken. Speaker A (Narrator): राहुल मुस्कुराता है, जिठानी कुछ नहीं बोलती। किचन में जाकर सास से बोलती है... [Rahul smiles, the sister-in-law says nothing. She goes to the kitchen and says to the mother-in-law...] Speaker B (Jethani): इसको इंग्लिश कहां से आई? पहले चुप रहती थी, ताने सुनती थी, अंदर रहती थी जब गेस्ट आते थे। [Where did she get English from? Earlier she used to stay quiet, listen to taunts, stay inside when guests came.] Speaker C (Bahu): एक दिन सोचा ताने सुनके रोना बंद करो। इंग्लिश सीखो और जवाब दो। इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड किया। जनरल इंग्लिश शो खोला। 'हेलो से बात शुरू करें' से स्टार्ट किया। 1 लाख से ज्यादा लोग देख चुके थे। फिर अपने बारे में बताओ, फिर अपनी फैमिली इंट्रोड्यूस करें, सब हिंदी में समझाया था। एआई कोच से रोज रात को प्रैक्टिस करती थी। 'Nice to meet you', 'How was your trip', 'I am still learning, but I practice every day'. 500 बार गलत बोला, 500 बार सुधारा। कभी नहीं बोली 'गांव की है, तुझसे नहीं होगा'। एक महीने में बेसिक कॉन्फिडेंस आया, दो महीने में गेस्ट के सामने बोल पाई। अब जिठानी ताना नहीं मारती, क्योंकि जवाब इंग्लिश में आता है। इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो, जनरल इंग्लिश शो खोलो, एआई कोच से प्रैक्टिस करो। ₹1 का ट्रायल है, रोज 15 मिनट दो। ताने सुनना बंद करो, इंग्लिश में जवाब देना शुरू करो। [One day I thought, stop crying over taunts. Learn English and reply. Downloaded English Seekho app. Opened General English Show. Started with 'Start conversation with Hello'. More than 1 lakh people had watched it. Then 'tell about yourself', then 'introduce your family', everything was explained in Hindi. Practiced with AI coach every night. 'Nice to meet you', 'How was your trip', 'I am still learning, but I practice every day'. Spoke wrong 500 times, corrected 500 times. It never said 'you are from a village, you can't do it'. Got basic confidence in one month, was able to speak in front of guests in two months. Now sister-in-law doesn't taunt, because the reply comes in English. Download English Seekho app, open General English Show, practice with AI coach. There is a ₹1 trial, give 15 minutes daily. Stop listening to taunts, start replying in English.] Speaker E (Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A daughter-in-law from a village is humiliated by her sister-in-law for her lack of English skills and told to hide from an NRI guest. She secretly learns English using the English Seekho app's AI coach and courses, eventually speaking fluently to impress the guest and silence her sister-in-law. The ad promotes a 1-rupee trial of the app to help users speak English confidently.
